details: Reviewed the existing orchestrator, evidence models/store, executor, CLI, agent boundary, and benchmark evaluator before changing the architecture.
Added a structured Investigator prompt, parser, and Investigation model for expected behavior, reported failure, triggers, likely files, reproduction strategy, and risk areas.
Allowed the Iteration 1 path to move from investigated directly to original_verified while retaining the future reproduction branch.
Added the advanced verification flow: Investigator, original/patched existing-test execution, evidence recording, evidence-constrained verifier, run manifest, and explicit capability limitations.
Added batch evaluation for Advanced Iteration 1 with verdict accuracy, false acceptance, runtime, confusion matrix, per-case run IDs, and persisted reports.
Added refute verify and refute eval-advanced commands.
Added a deterministic fake-LLM test covering the two model calls, original/patched execution, verdict persistence, evidence JSONL, and capability manifest.
Created trace-004 as part of the same implementation round rather than reconstructing it later.
Local pytest and Ollama benchmark execution are required before this trace is closed.
